111000101.text: #Hey, {NICKNAME}... Is it just Paimon, or is there something weird about those hilichurls over there?

111000103.text: Paimon thinks so too. We've seen plenty of hilichurls before, and they're always the bad guys... but this is different.

111000106.text: Uh-oh, this is right by the Wangshu Inn, too. The guests are in great danger!

111000107.text: #Now that we've seen it, if we don't do anything about it, Paimon will feel really guilty... Let's go take care of them, {NICKNAME}!

111000105.text: Right! Maybe it has something to do with that sorta... dark energy they're giving off?

subQuests.subQuestName: Defeat the hilichurls with the evil aura

111000301.text: These super evil hilichurls are more difficult to defeat than the usual kind, too.

111000302.text: Hey, seems like people are gathering over there... Wonder what they're doing?

111000303.text: Whoa, see that guy in the mask? He—He scared off all the hilichurls!

111000306.text: Oh, you mean like Xiao? Now that you mention it, this guy's mask is kinda similar to the one that he wears...

111000307.text: But the magic he was using seemed even more adeptus-y than Xiao's. Shall we go say hi?

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the man in the mask

111001001.text: Ahem. Hello! Allow us to introduce ourselves, this—

111001002.text: Please, if you're here to thank me, there's no need. Cleansing the world of evil is the duty of the adepti. Think nothing of it — One certainly doesn't.

111001003.text: ...Wait, who are you? One had assumed you were followers, but on closer inspection it seems that we have not met.

111001005.text: #My name's Paimon! And this is my sidekick, {NICKNAME}.

111001006.text: One sees. One, too, shall introduce oneself, for it is good manners to comply.

111001010.text: Ahem... The one before you is the adeptus, Master of Stars, though one is better known to one's followers as "Starsnatcher."

111001011.text: One descended from one's mountain abode to cleanse the world of evil, whereupon fate saw fit that our paths should cross. Now... tell me that which you wish for.

111001012.text: Our wishes? Paimon thought that the adepti in Liyue were just really good in battle... You mean you can grant people's wishes, too?

111001013.text: Hah... There are different levels of adepti... Are not the stars loftier than the mountains, clouds, and moon?

111001014.text: Yet, it is unbecoming of an adepti to boast of one's powers. One would have you first speak to one's followers, and only then make your verdict.

111001008.text: #My name's Paimon! And this is my sidekick, {NICKNAME}.

111001009.text: Then it is right that our paths coincide. I, too, shall introduce myself, for with good manners to comply.

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the followers to find out about Starsnatcher

111000401.text: Have you seen the Master of Stars in action? His power truly hails from the divine!

111000402.text: I believe that now, there is finally some hope for my ailing father...

111000403.text: Tell me about the Master of Stars.

111000404.text: Watching him use his magic is all the proof you need. A true adeptus, no doubt about it.

111000405.text: Not long ago, I sought some medicine from him on behalf of my ailing father. The difference with Bubu Pharmacy's prescriptions was like night and day, I tell you.

111000406.text: Once it was boiled and ready, it gave off this really ethereal mist — seemed pretty adeptal to me! Hm... Could have also been because there was Mist Flower in it, though...

111000407.text: Adepti medicine is surely the most potent. My father will recover soon, I just know it...

111000408.text: Sure, you have to make some sacrifices if you seek help from an adeptus like the Master of Stars — I had to give a few antiques as offerings. But my father's life is worth much more than a few old relics, right?

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the followers to find out about Starsnatcher

111000501.text: Finally, a life full of hope and purpose...

111000502.text: What are your thoughts on the Master of Stars?

111000504.text: After my fiancé upped and left, I cried every day...

111000505.text: But then I turned to the Master of Stars for help. At his suggestion, I started burning paintings of my fiancé and casting the ashes into the ocean at sunrise...

111000506.text: I can't explain it... but it really worked! I know in my heart that he will return. This is not some sort of positive thinking trick... I am certain of it.

111000507.text: I'm so overjoyed that I gave a portion of my wedding budget to the Master of Stars as an offering. After all, if not for him, I wouldn't be getting my fiancé back, in which case I wouldn't need it anyway...

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the followers to find out about Starsnatcher

111000601.text: The Millelith don't really need to do shifts when the Master of Stars is around, do they?

111000602.text: What do you know about the Master of Stars?

111000603.text: I'm a merchant, and I had an especially valuable batch of goods that needed transporting recently. So, I asked the Master of Stars if he would make the journey with me, as presumptuous as that was.

111000604.text: Reason being, monsters run a mile as soon as he so much as holds up his talisman. We didn't have the slightest bit of trouble the whole journey.

111000605.text: It didn't come cheap, of course... but then, soliciting the services of an adeptus is a monumental affair — just look at the Rite of Descension! So I can accept it, but I doubt that most from outside of Liyue would be willing to...

111000801.text: What do you think? One's adherents may exaggerate a little, but they speak from the heart.

111000803.text: Haha, surely you jest. There was once a senior adeptus, Xue Wuliang, known to the people as "Liangzi." He said this:

111000804.text: "All things are connected. That which mortals call 'imagination' is merely the bridge betwixt the spiritual and the material."

111000805.text: In other words, their wishes are already on the path of transitioning into reality. Does this make things clearer?

111000806.text: Ahh... Nope, it makes them way more complicated... But basically, what you're saying is that their wishes can come true, right?

111000807.text: Indeed. You are perceptive, my diminutive friend.

111000808.text: Okay. Um, so we also have one other question...

111000814.text: One... wanders among mortals, doing good and cleansing evil. One reveals not one's visage to avoid further disturbance to this realm than is necessary.

111000816.text: Now, then — what are your wishes?

111000812.text: Hey! Isn't that a bit inappropriate?

111000813.text: Hm. Indeed, it would be inappropriate for one to remove one's mask.

111002301.text: Chat with them as you please. One will not beat one's own drum — the words of others shall ring truer.
